scenes.audio: He is the Davis Cup captain for Australia. Game De Minaur.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A white male coach with a fair complexion, short brown hair, and blue eyes is sitting in the stands. He is wearing a white t-shirt and a dark baseball cap. Next to him sits another male in a yellow shirt. The scene then cuts to a wide shot of a tennis court during a match where a player in white and maroon hits a serve.

scenes.audio: Tennis ball sounds, grunts from the players.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The tennis match continues. A player in a maroon shirt and white cap, with light brown hair, is serving. The opponent, a male with dark hair and a beard wearing a brown and white shirt, returns the ball. The rally continues with both players moving across the court.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon celebrates after winning a point, pumping his fist. He is a white male with a slender build, light brown hair, wearing a maroon shirt, white shorts, and a white cap.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The coach from the opening scene claps while sitting in the stands. He is still wearing his white t-shirt and dark cap. The scene then cuts to the player in maroon walking on the court, adjusting his cap.

scenes.audio: Tennis ball sound. Game and first set, De Minaur, by 6 games to 3. A quite brilliant finish.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon is preparing to serve again. A white car is visible in the background. He serves, and the player in brown returns it into the net. The player in maroon walks across the court, looking focused.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The players are in another long rally. The player in brown, a male with a dark beard and dark hair wearing a white cap and brown shirt, is serving. They exchange several groundstrokes.

scenes.audio: Tennis ball sounds, player grunts. Finally! And you would have felt for Khachanov, and you would have feared for Khachanov if he hadn't won that point.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The rally continues. Both players are hitting hard shots and moving dynamically. The player in brown hits a shot that is just wide. He walks towards the net, looking frustrated.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Crowd members are visible in the stands. Then, the player in maroon wipes his face with a towel near the side of the court while a ball boy stands nearby.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon prepares for a serve and hits it. The rally starts and goes back and forth. The player in maroon eventually wins the point.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon walks back to his service position, holding his racquet and looking determined.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A new point begins with the player in maroon serving. The player in brown returns, and they engage in a baseline exchange. The player in brown hits a winner down the line.

scenes.audio: Makes him play the one extra ball, Khachanov.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in brown celebrates the winner, then adjusts his white cap. He is still in his brown and white outfit.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: A long rally occurs where both players show great athleticism. The player in maroon hits a lob, and the player in brown tries to track it down but hits it wide.

scenes.audio: Oh! All right now, it's 2 v 1.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The players continue the game. The player in maroon is now seen walking back as the camera cuts to a close-up of the player in brown, looking disappointed.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The match continues with another rally. The player in maroon is serving. The player in brown is defending from the baseline but the maroon player hits a drop shot.

scenes.audio: He even goes for the drive volley. Crowd applause.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon celebrates another point. He walks to the side, then the camera shows the crowd in the stands clapping.

scenes.audio: Game! It's a huge win for Alex De Minaur! It moves him ahead of Djokovic in the race for Turin.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The player in maroon hits a serve that the opponent cannot return. The match ends, and the player in maroon shouts in celebration. The two players meet at the net and shake hands.

scenes.audio: Music fades in, upbeat tempo with synthesizers.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Final shot of the stadium as the players leave the court. The screen then fades to a dark blue background with white geometric lines and links to 'Watch More' and 'Subscribe'.
